mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cage_permission_capability WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, code ASC
SELECT * FROM cage_permission_grant ORDER BY capability_code ASC, identity_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO cage_permission_grant (capability_code, identity_code) VALUES (#{capabilityCode}, #{identityCode})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cage_permission_grant WHERE capability_code = #{capabilityCode} AND identity_code = #{identityCode}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cage_member_capability WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY capability_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO cage_member_capability (user_id, capability_code, granted_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{capabilityCode}, #{grantedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT capability_code FROM cage_region_capability WHERE region_type = #{regionType} AND region_id = #{regionId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY capability_code ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(region_type, ':', region_id)) FROM cage_region_capability WHERE (region_type, region_id) IN
(#{r.regionType}, #{r.regionId})

SELECT region_type AS regionType, region_id AS regionId, capability_code AS capabilityCode, enabled AS enabled FROM cage_region_capability WHERE (region_type, region_id) IN
(#{r.regionType}, #{r.regionId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cage_region_capability WHERE region_type = #{regionType} AND region_id = #{regionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_region_capability (region_type, region_id, capability_code, configured_by, enabled) VALUES (#{regionType}, #{regionId}, #{capabilityCode}, #{configuredBy}, #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), configured_by = VALUES(configured_by)
